Name: Void's Weird Wonders - Weird UI
Author: VoidWitchCult
Description:
[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/zD09S1Rm/title2-1-mod-details.png[/img]
﻿
It's been in my mind for a good while already....while I enjoyed the Earthy Recolor a lot I wanted it to be darker, moody, weird...so this little UI Recolor was born! 

Fitting to my weird series, but dark and moody for anyone who likes a little bit of edgyness, haha. It includes some buttons for other mods to fit in that you you throw right into their respective folder! 

Please, please use Font settings as suggested so you can turn off the shadows or otherwise the text won't be readable because of the dark UI.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/L65Gx0zJ/title2-1-installation.png[/img]
﻿
 - Install the latest version of SMAPI and Content Patcher.
- Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
- Run the game using SMAPI.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/FzBk4Tg2/title2-1-campatibility.png[/img]
Compatible....well. Not with any other UIs lol. Otherwise...
